facts.fact: 出租车司机在 Grayne's 校门外停车，让 Phil 自己下车走进校门（"You can walk from here."）。
Phil 推开车门、从出租车里爬出来看爆炸。
facts.anchor: Phil pushed open the door and scrambled out of the taxi

facts.fact: Phil 伸手自我介绍，报出全名 Philomela Fen。
facts.anchor: ‘Fen,’ Phil said, offering her hand, ‘Philomela Fen.’

facts.fact: Elizabeth James 与 Phil 握手并自报姓名。
facts.anchor: ‘Elizabeth James.’ The girl shook her hand.

facts.fact: Elizabeth 介绍 Anne 与 Casey 是自己的两名 prefect（级长）。
facts.anchor: And these are Anne and Casey, two of my prefects.

facts.fact: Elizabeth 告诉 Phil：Miss Day 是 Miss Jagerson 的秘书，找她即可。
facts.anchor: She’s Miss Jagerson’s secretary. You’ll want to speak to her.

facts.fact: 叙述交代 Elizabeth 的年龄是 eighteen，或明显的 seventeen。
facts.anchor: She was clearly eighteen – or a notably mature seventeen

facts.fact: Miss Day 对电话说 Miss Jagerson 到了，并称校长要求 Phil 一到就直接送进去。
facts.anchor: the Headmistress did ask me to send you in directly you arrived
